title: 沿街的字
standfirst: 招牌伸向路中，字落在车身与墙上。沿街看过去，行人和一只落脚的鸟也进入它们之间。
standfirstEn: Signs reach towards the road; lettering sits on cars and walls. Along the street, people and a perching bird enter the same frame.
introduction: 横过街面的行人，挤在车道里的电车和巴士，一块向路中伸出的红色招牌。另一幅里，黑色大字包住红灯笼，远处的小字继续沿店铺排列。字首先有一个尺寸，也有一处位置。
十幅照片从街道纵深转到门头与墙，再靠近车身和一只鸟的落脚处。店名、海报和涂绘与电线、车辆、人物并列：海报上的手留在玻璃后，骑车的人从画在墙上的脸旁经过。最后，博物馆牌与刻字石碑各自托住一只鸟。
introductionEn: People cross a street among trams and buses. A red sign projects towards the road. In another picture, large black characters follow a red lantern, while smaller signs continue along the shops behind it. Lettering first has a size and a position.

Ten photographs move from the depth of the street to frontages and walls, then closer to a car and a bird’s perch. Shop names, posters and painted figures share the frame with wires, vehicles and people. Hands on a poster remain behind glass; a rider passes faces painted on a wall. At the end, a museum sign and a carved stone marker each support a bird.

chapters.title: 上下之间
chapters.text: 店招从墙上伸出，电线在头顶交叉，白字铺在路面。车辆与人物经过近处，文字仍沿着街道的两边排列。
chapters.textEn: Signs project from walls, wires cross overhead and white lettering lies on the road. Vehicles and people occupy the foreground as words line the sides of the street.

chapters.title: 墙与车身
chapters.text: 工具海报贴在玻璃后，黄色的字沿着车身铺开。墙上的涂绘与骑车人的背影相邻，文字从门面走到日常经过的路上。
chapters.textEn: Tool posters sit behind glass; yellow lettering spreads along a car. Painted figures on a wall share the frame with a rider seen from behind. Words move from a frontage into the path of everyday traffic.

chapters.title: 停落
chapters.text: 红色标牌与刻字石碑各自留出一段上沿。文字先铺出平面，一只鸟又把这个平面变成可以落脚的位置。
chapters.textEn: A red signboard and a carved stone marker each offer an upper edge. Words occupy a surface; a bird makes that surface a place to perch.
